## Summary

Reconciles the repo's **3-way-conflicting** Tavily integration (`install_mcp.py` pinned `0.1.2`, an unpinned remote `tavily.json`, and `mcp-servers.md` using `@latest`) to a **single source of truth pinned at `tavily-mcp@0.2.20`**, and adopts the 0.2.x `map`/`crawl` tool surface in the deep-research engine only. Executed via the MDTM task `TASK-RF-tavily-mcp-0-2-x-20260623-010952` across all 8 integration clusters (C1–C8), folding in pre-execution reflect findings B1, H1–H4, M1–M5.

## Changes by cluster

- **C1 — install/config/version:** pin `install_mcp.py` to `tavily-mcp@0.2.20`; add a `default_parameters` registry field and inject a masked, compact `-e DEFAULT_PARAMETERS={"search_depth":"basic","max_results":10}` at install (API key masked in echoed commands, M1); delete the orphan `tavily.json` from **both** `src/` and `plugins/` (tracked, hand-maintained — provenance verified).
- **C2 — research engine:** adopt `tavily-map`/`tavily-crawl` **engine-only** (X5) with concrete per-tier `search_depth`/`extract_depth`/tools, discovery caps (`maps=2`, `crawls=1`, 50-URL crawl truncation), recency controls, domain-filter binding; make `MCP_Tavily.md` the canonical 0.2.x surface; maintain exact frontmatter↔prose parity (X7).
- **C7 — eval:** register `mcp_server.tavily` in **both** `capabilities.py` `_DEFAULT_CAPABILITY_SPECS` (M2) and `real.yaml`; add a capability-gated `E16` verification eval (`expect_tool_call: mcp__tavily__tavily-search`) that SKIPs cleanly without `TAVILY_API_KEY`; fix stale `mcp.tavily` docstrings → `mcp_server.tavily` (X4).
- **C3/C4/C5/C6 — consumers (light touch):** pointer-only edits to `/sc:research`, brainstorm, troubleshoot (Tier-2 `search_depth: advanced` override, M3b/M4), and reflect; the 8 `rf-*` agents + `sc-recommend` are confirmed **unchanged** and covered by the parity test.
- **C8 — docs:** align `mcp-servers.md` (`@latest`→`0.2.20`, Node 18+, capability pointer), de-inventory the deleted `tavily.json`, fix `docs/eval/retry.md` token, broaden `core/FLAGS.md` (+ `make sync-dev`/`verify-sync`).

## Tests

Ships **8 CI-safe drift-guard test files** (version single-pin, frontmatter↔prose parity, X5 map/crawl confinement, eval-capability registration, doc alignment, tier-2 consistency, etc.). Full suite: **45 passed, 1 skipped** (the live smoke is gated on `TAVILY_API_KEY`).

## Validation

- **Final QA gate:** 6 adversarial lens reviews (3 rf-qa structural + 3 rf-qa-qualitative). One CRITICAL caught by mutation testing — a doc-alignment drift test was scanning 0 files in this worktree (its dir-exclusion matched the `.dev` ancestor); **fixed and mutation-verified** (now scans 911 files and fails on an injected stale pin).
- **POST `/sc:reflect` (deep):** content **PASS** (calibrated confidence 0.93, all X1–X7 invariants hold, 0 regressions, 0 drift; 2 documented necessary deviations).

## Notable decision

Eval id `E-tavily-search` → **`E16`** — the FR-SCH2 eval-id regex forbids hyphens (`validate_eval_id` rejects `E-tavily-search` → exit 2). User-approved; descriptive name preserved in the eval `title`.
